name: Holly Watson
source: Though young, Holly is quite a successful writer. For as long as she can remember, she was the kind of girl who enjoyed living between the pages of a book rather than going to parties and doing all that extroverted stuff. Her books are now gaining quite a following, so she combines her job as a professional writer with an internship to finally earn her college degree. Despite her devoted fan base, she still can't believe her books are appreciated and she often acts insecurely around other people, feeling afraid of leaving her shell.
